annotations.title: Dutch car lookup by number plate (RDW)

description: Looks up a Dutch-registered car by its number plate (kenteken) in the official RDW register: make, model, first registration, fuel, CO2 emission, catalogue price, empty weight, when the periodic inspection (APK) is due and whether it is insured. With a taxable income it also gives the company car tax (bijtelling) for 2026, including the electric-car rate locked for 60 months from first registration. Live data from RDW Open Data.

plate.description: Dutch number plate, with or without dashes, e.g. AB-123-C

taxable_income.description: Taxable income per year before the bijtelling, for the company car tax (optional)
